name: opcua-bounded-context-rich-wire-decoding
instr:
gopcua cannot apply one bounded-decoding policy across OPC UA transport and secure-conversation input. Implement deterministic, contextual rejection of malformed or oversized frames before allocation or service dispatch without changing valid legacy traffic.

Enforce inclusive input, string, byte-string, and aggregate-allocation limits before exceeding any budget. Return every failure as `ua.DecodeError` with stable `DecodeErrorKind`, the absolute offset of the first invalid or unavailable byte, the complete nested section path, and a cause preserved through `errors.Is` and `errors.As`. Direct primitive and complete-frame decoding must identify the same first unavailable byte after nesting.

Validate complete UACP and UASC fixed prefixes, message and chunk types, and declared extents before payload allocation. Use `DecodeErrorInvalidValue` for invalid values, `DecodeErrorInvalidLength` for undersized declarations, and `DecodeErrorTruncated` for truncation. Reject size-invalid UACP frames before MessageHeader decoding, with one transport-relative path and no service value.

Select security headers by message type. Unsupported types consume and construct none. Each header consumes only its own bytes and preserves uint32 correlation values. After security processing, symmetric-token consumption leaves sequence bytes intact; sequence consumption leaves the complete remaining service budget.

Keep budgets coherent through decryption, sequence decoding, reassembly, and service deco
